verdict.rationale: Adyen documents webhooks that push event outcomes as soon as they are available, so you don't have to poll. This gives you event triggers, but you must build the rule logic and resulting actions in your own receiving system. Nothing shows a native rule engine for configuring 'when X happens, do Y' inside Adyen. Missing for 10: native user-definable rules or conditions, built-in automated actions on events, POS-specific event-trigger documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
